reviews.title: Absolutely essential to my life - unparalleled in quality.
reviews.text: I don’t believe I’ve ever written a review on an app. I’m taking the time to write this because this app is THAT outstanding. It’s become essential to my daily life. I regularly need to scan documents in and then access them via my computer. I considered buying a more expensive scanner, but with this app, there is simply no need. If I hold my camera at the wrong angle, Genius Scan fixes it for me. It compensates for angles and bumps and misalignments and churns out an absolutely professional looking scan in seconds. It’s so accurate, it genuinely looks like it was a saved document, never having been printed and scanned. If, for some reason, my document is wonky and scans a weird edge, Genius scan lets me fix it. Over and above its perfect scans, it allows me to export…down to the very subfolder… of my Google Drive, my Microsoft OneDrive and even my Apple Files. I can email it to myself or someone else. It’s just seamless. I’m continually more and more impressed with this app and it’s saved me so much time and money, I cannot be more thankful for this app. Well done, devs, well done. 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻

reviews.title: EXCELLENT!
reviews.text: I have used a lot of different scanner apps. Most of them work but that’s about as much if you can say for them. They are not excellent, and in most cases are not even great. They are just simply functional. I went to the office of a notary to have a paper notarized and I just made an offhand comment that I was headed for a copy shop to have the documents scanned and turned into a PDF file. He answered back that he was able to do that for me. I was shocked to see him whip out his phone and snap a picture of it. I expect the results to be as bad as all of the other ones that I have used in the past and I couldn’t believe my eyes. It corrects for Keystone distortion, and it removes trace background edges around the page. Actually work better when placed on a darker background so there’s more distinction between the edge of the page and the background itself. I would like to extend a high-five to the developer of this app. You have really done and astonishingly good job. Congratulations.

reviews.title: The Online Student’s Savior
reviews.text: i’ve been in online school since the beginning of the pandemic, and this app is a lifesaver. it doesn’t limit how many documents you scan like other apps, and its automatic scanning trick is pretty okay. just don’t but the paper on a light colored surface, or have too many other objects in the frame. my favorite part is the ability to directly upload from my phone to the desktop of my computer (since they’re linked by icloud). if that’s not your speed, you can airdrop it to your downloads folder. the back and white filter is just as good as a printer scan, and there’s an option to edit the document after you take the photo. I never needed any other part of the app, so i didn’t need premium, which is amazing. it also uploads as a pdf, which saves me all the trouble of converting it myself. compared to other scan apps, i found this one to be the most efficient, since it works well and doesn’t have any frustrating limits for free users.

reviews.title: Works great!…most of the time.
reviews.text: I use this app to scan documents for my university classes. Once scanned, the features within the app provide augmentations, such as leaving natural light or white light (i.e, displaying the visual differences between a photo or a “scan” of the document). I also love that if I’m scanning dozens of pages all at once, if I make a mistake on one scan, I have the option to re-do that scan rather than starting over just to ensure the documents are in order. Once satisfied, I can email the document (however large or small) and it will appear instantly in my inbox. The one issue I’ve found, is that sometimes it does not appear in my inbox until hours or even a day after I scanned my work. This can be EXTREMELY frustrating when my deadline is that evening. There’s no way to assess when these hiccups occur, since it appears to have no correlation to document size or scanning frequency. Overall, I’m thankful to have this app. It’s so much faster to use than my physical printer/scanner.

reviews.title: Mixed feelings
reviews.text: Update: After the developers responded, I took a closer look at the user manual and tried it again. The hotspot is no longer a problem (that one is a puzzle, since I didn’t do anything), file naming help was there after all, and works VERY well (using a field to insert part of the name each time). And I got authorized to give Google permissions to view and download all my files, which makes me very uncomfortable, but it makes this project work like a dream. I was thrilled with how well Genius Scan autocrops documents—would save me a lot of time! However, subscribing was a big disappointment. I expected file naming help, and got none, am finding hot spots (lighter scan) on documents no matter how I arrange lighting, and worst of all, exporting to Google Drive (which I REALLY wanted) is impossible because I refuse to give Genius Scan access and permission to download all of my files. So all in all, guess I’ll be going back to Google Scan.

reviews.text: This app seems too good to be true, but, rest assured, it’s the real deal!!! It has every feature I’ve ever wanted in a scanner app and much more! I’ve literally tried 10 or 15 scanner apps, and I had given up on finding one that did what I needed it to! Then I found Genius Scan, and WOW! It’s a million times better than Adobe Scan, which is crazy because you’d think Adobe would be the gold standard, but it’s not! By a long shot! Genius is the gold standard. What I love about this app: Clean scans every time! Strait pages every time! It picks up the color signature on a black and white document, which most scanning apps don’t. Ease of navigation / use! Incredibly fair price!! Really! Automatic naming templates! Highly accurate OCR. Document tagging. Rules that email or upload files based on name/tags. THE KICKER: Auto upload to my cloud provider. Example: After I scan a document, it assigns a name template automatically! After I edit the template to add the respective custom data for that particular scan, Genius then AUTOMATICALLY uploads that document to a predefined folder in Google Drive so I can grab it and email it to my client. I can NOT tell you how much time that saves me each day! What I dislike about this app: Literally NOTHING! I highly recommend this app to you. For $30/year, you simply cannot go wrong! I love it and cannot speak highly enough about the quality of the app and the richness of the features the developers have built into this app. I’ll definitely be looking at the other apps they have to offer!

reviews.title: Almost perfect 4.5 stars
reviews.text: I’d give Genius Scan 4.5 stars, if I could. I’ve been using Genius Scan for a few years and I really like it. I mostly use it to scan my kids’ artwork so that I can clear the paper clutter. More recently I’ve begun using it to scan my own childhood art which my parents have recently given me. As an app it works quite well, and I really like having it on my phone for a quick scan before something gets recycled. Some things I’d like to see improved are: better color detection in the Color filter without having to save it as a photo on the app (different filter options are None, B&W, Color, and Photo); option of pre-set crops (e.g., square, rectangle, fixed corners) along with the standard manually-determined crop; ability to add notes to a scanned document. The ability to add notes is particularly important to me, as I would like to add personal notes about the document, rather than put it all in the document title.

reviews.title: Hard to Read
reviews.text: Writing on the PDFs appear as a bunch of illegible dots unless the text you are scanning is very bold and you have the proper lighting. Although other than this the app works well enough, it has caused me much frustration from often having to go over all of my writing pressing harder down on the paper, only to find that it still doesn’t work. I also find myself having to scan again because it renders my work sideways, or fails to cut out the background. Also, while you are in the process of scanning, you can’t undo a single page. You either have to keep it or delete all of the scanned pages. I suppose you could always just keep redoing each page until you get it right, and go through them at the end, deleting all but those that you’re satisfied with, but with the amount of attempts that would take and the amount of pages you’ll have to go through and delete in the end, this would be a time consuming process, and you’re probably better off just getting a different app.

I use it literally every day to scan mail (and then throw it out), scan forms or documents I have to sign and send back, scan recipes, etc. It works beautifully and is worth the cost. reviews.text: I’ve been using Genius Scan for several years to quickly scan documents and file them away on Dropbox or OneDrive. I know those services have their own apps that do document scanning, but they’re clunkier and don’t have the breadth of features that Genius Scan does. reviews.title: Perfect Scanner!
reviews.text: The best there is! This app has allowed me to conquer my administrative demons that had me invariably fumbling, misplacing, and losing critical and irreplaceable documents. I’ve tried and bought at least a dozen other premium scanner apps and this app (Genius Scan) blows them all away. Every size and shape document along with it’s detailed data is precisely copied into a PDF and/or text formatted file along with various filters, editing and manipulation options to generate a perfectly replicated document.
